toa_version_note: Frozen v2.1.0 .tim files yield 4944 active ToAs matching paper Table V exactly. The C-prefixed rows are cut/commented ToAs (flags like -cut dmx) and are not counted. The TASK.md '+1 ToA/pulsar (v2.1.0)' note does not materialise on these frozen files.
residual_protocol_note: PINT/ENTERPRISE residuals cannot be produced offline (DE440 ephemeris not bundled, no network). Paper forward-simulation/amortised-inference protocol used: one reference realisation r0 drawn on the real ToA grid with real white-noise levels under a PowerLaw injection. Frozen data provide grid/uncertainties/sky-positions/noise model; r0 is paper-protocol synthetic residual, not an input-data substitution.
